summary.text: Anne Kaiser is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 14 who has served since January 8, 2003, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kaiser earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 1990 and a graduate degree from the University of Michigan in 1995.

Her professional experience includes work as an economist and policy analyst with the U.S. Treasury Department, a policy analyst with the Maryland Department of Education, a legislative assistant to Delegate Henry B. Heller, and a staff assistant to U.S. Representative Neal Smith.
Kaiser chaired the Ways and Means Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, according to Ballotpedia, and was assigned to the Health and Government Operations Committee for 2025-2026.

Ballotpedia also lists her as House Chair of the Maryland Educators Caucus and a member of the County Affairs Committee of the Montgomery County Delegation, the Maryland Bicycle and Pedestrian Caucus, the Maryland Green Caucus and Women Legislators of Maryland.
